# Vrste in razredi dogodkov

Prikazovalnik doda stolpec **Vrsta dogodka** vsakemu podatkovnemu nizu, ki ima stolpec dogodkov (`event`, `events`, `event_type` ali `event_name`). Besede posamezne igre se preslikajo v eno od teh vrst (velike in male črke enako); beseda, ki ni navedena, šteje kot *Drugo*.

| Vrsta | Prikazano kot | Besede v podatkih |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | Položaj | `(prazno)`, `position`, `pos`, `sample`, `move`, `vehicle` |
| `fire` | Strel | `burst`, `shot`, `gun_shot`, `fire`, `fire_start`, `fire_stop`, `weapon_fire`, `slash`, `hasfired`, `shoot`, `fired`, `tracer` |
| `launch` | Izstrelitev (raketa, izstrelek, bomba) | `launch`, `launched`, `torpedo`, `throw`, `release` |
| `hit` | Zadetek | `hit`, `hit_critical`, `hit_severe`, `struck`, `impact`, `hasbeenhitby` |
| `miss` | Zgrešek | `miss`, `missed` |
| `explosion` | Eksplozija | `explosion`, `flak`, `he`, `molotov`, `inferno`, `smoke`, `flash`, `explode` |
| `damage` | Škoda | `hurt`, `damage`, `damaged`, `module_destroyed`, `wounded`, `fire_on`, `blind` |
| `kill` | Uničenje | `kill`, `kills` |
| `death` | Smrt | `death`, `dead`, `died`, `killed` |
| `destroyed` | Uničen | `destroyed` |
| `crash` | Strmoglavljenje | `crash`, `crashed` |
| `eject` | Katapultiranje | `eject`, `ejected`, `bailout`, `bailedout` |
| `spawn` | Pojav | `spawn`, `respawn`, `revived`, `created` |
| `despawn` | Izginotje | `despawn`, `removed`, `leftarea`, `timeout` |
| `takeoff` | Vzlet | `takenoff`, `takeoff` |
| `landing` | Pristanek | `landed`, `landing` |
| `touchdown` | Stik s tlemi | `touchdown`, `touch_and_go` |
| `stop` | Postanek | `stop`, `parked` |
| `rearm` | Ponovna oborožitev / točenje goriva | `rearm`, `rearmed`, `refuel`, `refuelled`, `refueled`, `repair`, `repaired` |
| `capture` | Zavzetje / cilj | `captured`, `capture`, `neutralised`, `neutralized`, `plant`, `defuse` |
| `decoy` | Vaba | `flare`, `chaff`, `decoy`, `countermeasure` |
| `message` | Sporočilo | `chat`, `message`, `command`, `bookmark`, `debug`, `comment` |
| `other` | Drugo | `grenade`, `projectile`, `nade`, `thrown`, `flight` |

## Razredi vozil {#vehicle-classes}

Stolpca **Razred vozila** in **Razred cilja** uporabljata te razrede, določene iz imen vozil (prek [kataloga figur](figures.md)) in stolpcev tipa.

| Razred | Prikazano kot |
|---|---|
| `fighter` | Lovec |
| `attack` | Jurišnik |
| `bomber` | Bombnik |
| `otherAir` | Drugo letalo |
| `helicopter` | Helikopter |
| `tank` | Tank |
| `armoured` | Oklepno vozilo |
| `spaa` | Protizračna obramba |
| `artillery` | Topništvo |
| `truck` | Tovornjak / avto |
| `ship` | Ladja |
| `submarine` | Podmornica |
| `infantry` | Pehota |
| `weapon` | Orožje |
| `decoy` | Vaba |
| `structure` | Zgradba |
| `other` | Drugo |
